question: Can the two user-selected Cartesia/Tavus and Cartesia/Anam pairs run the existing training with prompt interruptions and preserved reports?
independent_assessment: Recorded quality is established by the user; microphone latency, lifecycle cleanup and preserving training context still need verification. Reuse existing server VAD, Smart Turn and training agent, replace TTS and presentation through adapters.
hypothesis: Streaming Cartesia audio to the chosen avatar can retain the existing training logic; local presentation must stop on server VAD before transcription.
baseline: Existing Pipecat training with Inworld and local GLB; six recorded comparisons remain untouched
acceptance: Methodist can select either profile for new sessions
Real generated text and streaming speech use the same scenario context
Speech-start stops local playback and provider queue before transcript
Late chunks and duplicate starts do not reopen cancelled speech
Disconnect, timeout and end close provider sessions
Text fallback and evidence-backed report work
primary_metric: Microphone speech-start to inaudible avatar audio; goal <= 300 ms
guardrails: End of user turn to first audible response target <= 2500 ms after warm-up
No double playback or avatar camera/microphone publishing
data_split: Not applicable; fixed synthetic Russian phrases for automated tests, human acceptance separately
stop_condition: Stop a probe on unclear quota, duplicate session or failed cleanup. Do not report live acceptance from mocked tests.
